newsitem.title: USA: One circuit of Wash.-Canada power line repaired.
newsitem.headline: One circuit of Wash.-Canada power line repaired.

text.p: One of the two circuits of the 500 kilovolt Raver-Schultz power line, running from Snohomish County, Wash. to Canada, was re-energized Thursday night, Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) said Friday.
But the line was taken off-line again early Friday so repairs to the second circuit could continue, a BPA spokeswoman said.
BPA hopes to have both lines back late tonight, she said.
The Raver-Schultz lines have been out of service since being damaged two weeks ago during an ice storm.
The federal power marketing agency has had to restrict hydroelectric power generation at certain dams due to voltage support concerns related to the transmission line outage.
But recent warmer weather for most areas of the Pacific Northwest has reduced demand for BPA's power, allowing the agency to offer surplus power during peak demand hours.
